However, Section 328 of the IPC would  not attract to the case under the Gutka and other offences are  bailable.
Therefore, interim protection may be granted.
5. The issue as regards the applicability of Section 328 of  the IPC is seized with the Hon'ble Supreme Court.
The Hon'ble  Supreme Court has granted the interim protection to the  applicants approached before Hon'ble Supreme Court.
There  are contradictory views of this Court as regards the  applicability of Section 328 of the IPC in the Gutka cases.

Considering the issue seized with the Hon'ble Supreme Court,
 the applicant may be released on interim protection.

Hence,
 the following order :
 ORDER (i) In the event of arrest, the applicant ABHAY RAMESHWAR REZA @ GUPTA be released on interim bail, on furnishing P.B. and S.B. of Rs.20,000/- (Rupees Twenty Thousand only) with one solvent surety of the like amount, in Crime No.204 of 2022, registered with Police Shirdi, District Ahmednagar, for the offences punishable under Sections 328, 188, 272, 273 of the IPC, Section 59,
26(2)(iv) of the Food Safety and 3 907-ABA.1127-22.odt Standards Act and Section 3/25 of the Arms Act, on the condition that he shall attend the Police Station as and when called by the Investigating Officer.
(S. G. MEHARE, J.) ...
